main.description: Deliver a sealed signal to a node listening on this relay. Not stored: fails if the recipient isn't connected. Requires a node-signed JWT; the relay sets the sender from it.

payload.description: 24-byte nonce followed by a NaCl box from the sender's signal key to the recipient's. Plaintext is an is.neuros.signal.defs object in DAG-CBOR.

errors.name: RecipientUnavailable
errors.description: The recipient isn't listening on this relay. Try another of its home relays.
